blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Parañaque Integrated Terminal Exchange (PITX) recorded more than 1.68 million passengers during the Undas exodus this year, the terminal said on Tuesday. In its latest data, PITX said a total of 1,686,201 passengers passed through the terminal from Sunday, Oct. 25, to Monday, Nov. 2. This figure was slightly higher than the 1,433,716 passengers recorded during the same period last year. PITX logged the highest number of passengers on Monday, Oct. 26, with 197,288.
